name: Forging Faith

provenance.detail: Josh opens Unspeakable Joy by naming a two-week miniseries called Forging Faith through 1 Peter 1, and opens Ransomed for Holiness as the second half of that same two-part series.
Jeremy confirmed Forging Faith as Unspeakable Joy and Ransomed for Holiness even though the series name is not printed on the thumbnails.

description: A two-week look at 1 Peter 1: faith purified in the fire, then holiness from ransom blood.
note: Josh says they will probably return to 1 Peter later. Week one is living hope and unspeakable joy; week two is walking in holiness as ransomed living stones.

provenance.detail: Josh names Forging Faith, reads 1 Peter 1:1-12, and gives eight situations where faith is forged.
Jeremy confirmed Unspeakable Joy as Forging Faith.
Josh calls Forging Faith a two-part series and covers the back half of 1 Peter 1, shifting from hope to holiness.
Jeremy confirmed Ransomed for Holiness as Forging Faith.
